notes: Current-generation Aer 2 (SKU 440200); 14.3 lb, from-birth capable, larger basket than Aer+. Clek lists 'Aer 2' as its own row with a distinct 'Aer 2 Car Seat Adapters' part (adapter-joolz-aer-2) — the Aer+ adapter does NOT fit the Aer 2 frame. The Aer 2 adapter listing explicitly names Clek. Best cited price $579 (Joolz DTC / Strolleria / Nordstrom, all in stock).
